results.content:
We tried several solutions out there today and none of them were a good fit. Cloud browsers (like browser-use) run in a datacenter, so logging into your accounts is a pain, and sites like Twitter and LinkedIn block you because you are on a datacenter IP. And headless browsers (like agent-browser) don't let you see what your agent is doing.

We realized what’s needed is a browser that is run locally, has your logins but can be easily driven by YOUR agents.

That’s what we built with BrowserOS neo! You import your logins from Chrome in one click and connect your agent (Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, OpenClaw, etc). And then you can start giving your agent any complex task and see it get magically done using neo! [...] Subscribe

results.title: BitBrowser Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
#### What needs improvement

The platform works well overall, but cloud phone profiles occasionally take longer to load than expected. The interface could also be more beginner-friendly, with clearer guidance for first-time users. Improving synchronization speed and adding more tutorials or onboarding resources would make the experience even better.

#### vs Alternatives

I also looked at a few other anti-detect browsers before making my decision. BitBrowser stood out because it combines browser profile management with cloud phone functionality, which matched my workflow better than the alternatives. The setup process was straightforward, and the pricing was also more reasonable for managing multiple accounts.

Ratings

Ease of use

Reliability

Value for money

Customization

Report [...] BitBrowser has made managing multiple cloud phone profiles much easier for my daily work. The profile isolation is reliable, which helps keep each account separate without worrying about fingerprints or cookies overlapping. Setting up a new cloud phone profile with a proxy is quick, and the cookie export feature saves a lot of time since I don't have to log in repeatedly. Performance is generally stable, and the Telegram support team has been responsive whenever I've needed help. Overall, it has simplified multi-account management while reducing the need for extra devices.

#### What needs improvement [...] Based on 116 reviews

Review BitBrowser?

Reviewers mostly see BitBrowser as a practical, reliable tool for managing many accounts with isolated profiles, smooth proxy setup, quick profile switching, and solid fingerprint protection. They often say it saves time, stays stable in daily use, and is easier to start with than competing anti-detect browsers. More technical users also praise the local API, automation support, and cloud phone workflows. The main complaints are a mild learning curve, cluttered or beginner-unfriendly advanced settings, occasional sync delays, and heavier memory use when many profiles are open.
